newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - USA Detergents cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - USA Detergents cut.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities said analyst Heather Hay cut her rating on USA Detergents Inc to hold from buy.
-- cited "lack of confidence in the company's near-term performance."
-- The company said Thursday after the market closed that it did not know if it would be profitable for the first quarter but that revenues would be slightly above analysts' expectations.
-- The company, which makes laundry and household cleaning products, is expected to report results on or about May 7, Hay said.
-- The shares closed up 3/8 to 18-3/8 Thursday.
